automatic-wash.definition: Automatic wash refers to a washing machine that automatically performs the washing process.
automatic-wash.exampleUsage: The automatic wash was used during the activity.

hand-wash.definition: Hand wash refers to washing a person's hands with soap.

self-service.definition: A system or method lets customers complete tasks or get goods and services without ongoing help from staff. Standard steps or technology usually guide the process.

touchless.definition: Touchless refers to a washing machine that does not require the person to touch the washing cycle.
touchless.exampleUsage: The touchless was used during the activity.

foam-wash.definition: Foam wash refers to a washing machine that uses foam to clean surfaces.
foam-wash.exampleUsage: The foam wash was used during the activity.

wax-wash.definition: Wax wash refers to a washing machine that uses wax to clean surfaces.
wax-wash.exampleUsage: The wax wash was used during the activity.

undercarriage.definition: Framework that serves as a support for the body of a vehicle.

wheel-wash.definition: A cleaning step that removes dirt and brake dust from a vehicle's wheels.
wheel-wash.exampleUsage: The wheel wash removed mud from the rims.

rinse.definition: To wash off soap or remaining dirt.

pressure-washer.definition: Pressure washer refers to a washing machine that uses pressure to clean surfaces.
pressure-washer.exampleUsage: The pressure washer was used during the activity.

foam-cannon.definition: Foam cannon refers to a cleaning tool that uses foam to clean surfaces.
foam-cannon.exampleUsage: The foam cannon was used during the activity.

brush.definition: A cleaning tool with many stiff hairs attached to a handle or base.
brush.exampleUsage: The brush was used during the activity.

roller.definition: A small wheel without spokes (as on a roller skate).

vacuum.definition: A machine that removes dirt by sucking in air.

air-freshener.definition: Air freshener refers to a cleaning product that uses air to freshen surfaces.

towel.definition: A piece of absorbent cloth used for drying your body or other things.

bucket.definition: The quantity contained in a bucket.

car-soap.definition: Car soap refers to a cleaning product that is used on cars.

wax.definition: A protective coating applied to a car to make its surface shine.

tire-shine.definition: Tire shine refers to a cleaning product that is used on tires.

glass-cleaner.definition: Glass cleaner refers to a cleaning product that is used on glass surfaces.

interior-cleaner.definition: Interior cleaner refers to a cleaning product that is used on interior surfaces.

polish.definition: A substance used to make a surface smooth and shiny.

clay-bar.definition: Clay bar refers to a cleaning product that is used to remove clay from surfaces.

microfiber.definition: A very fine synthetic fabric used for cleaning and drying surfaces without scratching them.
microfiber.exampleUsage: The worker dried the car with a microfiber cloth.

degreaser.definition: A chemical substance that dissolves water-insoluble substances, such as greases and oils.

protectant.definition: A product applied to a surface to help protect it from wear, sunlight, or dirt.
protectant.exampleUsage: The protectant helped keep the dashboard from fading.

hood.definition: The folding roof of a carriage.

roof.definition: The inner top surface of a covered area or hollow space.

trunk.definition: Compartment in an automobile that carries luggage or shopping or tools.
trunk.exampleUsage: The trunk was used during the activity.

bumper.definition: A glass filled to the brim (especially as a toast).

wheel.definition: A simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines).
wheel.exampleUsage: The wheel was used during the activity.

tire.definition: A rubber covering around a wheel that grips the road.

windshield.definition: Transparent screen (as of glass) to protect occupants of a vehicle.

bay.definition: A compartment on a ship between decks.

track.definition: A line or route along which something travels or moves.

conveyor.definition: A person who conveys (carries or transmits).

coin-machine.definition: A machine that begins operating when a person inserts a coin into its designated slot.
coin-machine.exampleUsage: The coin machine was used during the activity.

token.definition: Something serving as a sign of something else.

timer.definition: A device that measures or signals the end of baking time.
timer.exampleUsage: The timer was used during the activity.

drain.definition: An opening and pipe that carry used water away from a sink, bath, or shower.

sign.definition: A board showing rules or information.

menu-board.definition: A display that lists the available wash services and their prices or features.
menu-board.exampleUsage: The driver checked the menu board before choosing a wash.

waiting-area.definition: A room in a place such as an airport or hotel where people sit until they are ready to leave or be served.

pre-rinse.definition: A first rinse with water that loosens dirt before the main washing step.
pre-rinse.exampleUsage: The pre-rinse removed loose dust from the car.

soap-spray.definition: A sprayed layer of cleaning soap used to loosen dirt on a vehicle.
soap-spray.exampleUsage: The soap spray covered the doors with foam.

scrub.definition: The act of cleaning a surface by rubbing it with a brush and soap and water.

wax-coat.definition: A thin protective layer of wax applied to a vehicle's painted surface.
wax-coat.exampleUsage: The wax coat gave the paint a smooth shine.

blow-dry.definition: To dry a washed vehicle by directing moving air over its surface.
blow-dry.exampleUsage: Large dryers blow-dry the car near the exit.

hand-dry.definition: To dry a surface manually with towels or cloths after washing.
hand-dry.exampleUsage: The worker hand-dried the mirrors to prevent water spots.

vacuum-interior.definition: To remove dust and debris from the inside of a vehicle with a vacuum cleaner.
vacuum-interior.exampleUsage: They vacuumed the interior, including the seats and floor mats.

wipe-dash.definition: To clean the vehicle's dashboard by passing a cloth over its surface.
wipe-dash.exampleUsage: She wiped the dash with a soft cloth.

freshen.definition: To make something smell or feel clean and pleasant again.
